name: builderii
description: Your Builderii boards in ChatGPT: design app screens and clickable prototypes, draw flowcharts, mind maps, sequence diagrams, sitemaps, roadmaps and database diagrams, change the ones on your boards, brainstorm onto sticky notes, run Builderii's own AI, and leave review comments on the right screen or step.

interface.longDescription: Builderii is a visual workspace for flowcharts, app wireframes and prototypes, sequence diagrams, sitemaps, mind maps and whiteboards. Connect your Builderii account to design app screens as clickable prototypes, draw flowcharts, mind maps, sequence diagrams, sitemaps, roadmaps and database diagrams on your boards (and change the ones already there), turn a screenshot into screens, brainstorm onto sticky notes, use Builderii's own AI, read your boards, and review flows and screens with comments pinned where they belong. Builderii only sees and changes what your connected account can; disconnect it any time in Builderii's Settings.
defaultPrompt: Design the screens of a meal-planning app in Builderii
Map our sign-up process as a flowchart in Builderii
Turn this conversation into a mind map in Builderii

positive.description: Draw a flowchart on a new board from steps the user gives. Run first: cases 4 and 5 use what it makes.
positive.prompt: Map our sign-up process as a flowchart in Builderii: enter your email, enter the code we email you, choose a plan, then see the welcome screen.
positive.expected_behavior: A new board (named for the sign-up process) gets a flowchart from a start step through the four steps to an end, joined by arrows. ChatGPT confirms it and links to the board (https://app.builderii.com/b/…), which opens in Builderii.

positive.description: Design app screens as a clickable prototype.
positive.prompt: Design three phone screens for a meal-planning app in Builderii: this week's plan, a recipe, and a shopping list.
positive.expected_behavior: A new board gets three phone screens (week plan, recipe, shopping list) with realistic content, linked so Play in Builderii clicks through them. ChatGPT names the screens and links to the board.

positive.description: Turn a topic into a mind map.
positive.prompt: Make a mind map in Builderii of ideas for launching a podcast.
positive.expected_behavior: A new board gets a mind map with "Launch a podcast" (or similar) at the centre and branches such as format, equipment, guests, promotion and schedule, each with a few ideas. ChatGPT summarizes the branches and links to the board.

positive.description: Answer a question from the user's boards, with a link to the board it comes from.
positive.prompt: Search my Builderii boards for the sign-up process and list its steps.
positive.expected_behavior: Builderii finds the sign-up board (from case 1, or the demo account's sample board of that name) and ChatGPT lists its steps in order: enter your email, enter the code, choose a plan, the welcome screen, with a link to the board. It changes nothing.

positive.description: Leave a review comment pinned to the step it's about.
positive.prompt: On my Builderii sign-up flowchart, comment on the step where people enter the code: "What happens if the code has expired?"
positive.expected_behavior: A comment with that text is pinned beside the "enter the code" step on the sign-up board. ChatGPT confirms where it was left and links to the board, where the comment shows.

negative.description: "Brainstorm" here means a list in the chat, not sticky notes on a board: the user didn't mention Builderii or a board. ChatGPT should just list names and call no Builderii tool; it may offer to put them on a board, and does only if the user then asks.
negative.prompt: Brainstorm five names for a new bakery.

negative.description: A general question about design, answered from general knowledge. Nothing in the user's Builderii boards is needed, so no Builderii tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What's the difference between a wireframe and a prototype?

negative.description: A request for a picture, not a diagram on a board. ChatGPT should make or describe the image itself and call no Builderii tool.
negative.prompt: Draw a picture of a sunset over the ocean.

publication.release_notes: Builderii's first release in ChatGPT. Design app screens as clickable prototypes, draw flowcharts, mind maps, sequence diagrams, sitemaps, roadmaps and database diagrams on your boards and change the ones already there, brainstorm onto sticky notes, use Builderii's own AI, read your boards, and leave review comments on the right screen or step. Every result links back to the board in Builderii.
